welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.subtitle: Real-time deadlift form analysis powered by on-device AI. Create an account to save sessions, or continue as a guest to explore the app.
welcome.featureBody: MoveNet Lightning tracks pose keypoints from the camera for instant form cues on each rep — no extra wearables required.
welcome.step1Body: Place your phone 5–7 feet away with a full-body view from the side.
welcome.step2Body: Execute your set as normal. The AI detects start and end points automatically.
welcome.step3Body: Receive instant feedback on depth, pathing, and tempo.
welcome.infoNote: Guest mode lets you try workouts locally. Sign in to sync progress and unlock full Stats history.
welcome.languageSub: Choose your preferred language for the app.

support.title: Support & contact
support.emailBody: For account help, data requests, or bug reports, email us. We typically respond within a few business days.
support.helpBody: For form analysis tips, place your phone 5–7 feet away with a full side view of your body. Ensure good lighting and keep the barbell in frame. Exercise feedback generated by the app may be inaccurate and should not be relied upon as a substitute for professional coaching or medical advice.
support.researchBody: RepRight is developed at Universidad Iberoamericana (UNIBE) for academic research on exercise form analysis using on-device computer vision.
support.diagBody: If the app crashed, reopen it and tap Share diagnostics below. Paste the report into your support email — it includes the exact JS error message and session steps.
support.footer: RepRight · UNIBE · Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic
